data_output.description: data.encode(splits) remains unchanged and returns (encoded, dimension). encoded["train"] is (train_features, train_labels, train_users), where train_users is aligned one-to-one with training rows and is derived from the exact raw user_id field. encoded["valid"] remains (valid_features, valid_labels, valid_users) in canonical selected source-row order.

model_input.description: Model.step(features, labels, sample_weights=None) accepts features shaped (batch_rows, 7), labels shaped (batch_rows,), and optional finite nonnegative float32-compatible sample_weights shaped (batch_rows,). Trainer supplies globally mean-one normalized inverse training-user-impression-count weights. Model.predict(features) continues to return one raw-logit score per input row in unchanged order.
